rules: Only copy independently confirmed public base facts into location master records.
Keep source URLs and last verified date.
Keep venue-level info separate from area-level properties and tournament-level fee/scoring/check-in.
Do not store access codes in GitHub or standard participant mail templates.
No automatic production DB writes; admin integration and review required.

Store venue logo in full-size original plus email-friendly PNG and optional square variant, with attribution/source, usage approval, alt text and review status; keep logos optional in published output.

asset_archive.note: Source Drive file IDs document findability, not automatic public hotlinks. Download/copy approved high-resolution assets into managed image storage before publishing. Avoid deriving logos from low-resolution posters.
